Date/time: 26 Jan 2025 1200 (ship's time UTC)

Next port: Sept-Iles

Remarks: Main engine stopped 0610-1140 UTC to repair a hydraulic oil leak on the steering gear. Leak repaired, steering tested, passage resumed. Average speed over 18.5 h steaming. Fuel used during stoppage: VLSFO 1.1 t (generators and boiler).

Master MV TORMAR SPRING

result.result:
The Master's ETA of 2025-01-31T11:00 UTC to Sept-Iles is consistent: check_eta computes 2025-01-31T12:18 UTC from the 1,503.8 nm distance at 12.5 kn, within the 2-hour tolerance (−1.3 h). check_notices finds no ETA notice due now — the last notice was sent on 2025-01-25 at 5 days before arrival (next thresholds are 3, 2, 1 days), so no notice goes out to the agent yet.

The remarks explain the stop (main engine stopped 0610–1140 UTC on 26 Jan to repair a hydraulic oil leak on the steering gear), so no query to the Master is needed. check_stoppage agrees: the 5.5-hour stop with 1.1 t VLSFO used fits the report's 18.5 steaming hours at 12.5 kn over 231.3 nm.

Judgement on the CP off-hire clause: a steering gear breakdown is breakdown of machinery preventing full working of the vessel, so the whole stop is off hire; under the clause all bunkers used while off hire are for the owners' account. The off-hire statement from the voyage management system (simulated, made-up figures for this demo) gives: hire deduction US$2,177.08 for 5.5 hours (0.2292 days at US$9,500/day), bunkers US$660 (1.1 t VLSFO at US$600/t) to the owners' account, total US$2,837.08 to the owners' account.

The operator should decide whether to put the ship off hire for 2025-01-26T06:10–11:40 UTC and notify the owner Tormar Bulk Carriers. On a yes: (a) propose an off_hire entry in the voyage management system for that period, and (b) e-mail the owner's vessel technical management giving the period and the machinery-breakdown reason and asking for the engine log extract for the stop.

draft.subject: off-hire notice MV TORMAR SPRING
draft.body:
Dear Owner,

This is to advise that MV TORMAR SPRING (IMO SIM-0002) will be placed off hire from 26 Jan 2025 06:10 UTC to 11:40 UTC due to a machinery breakdown — a hydraulic oil leak on the steering gear was repaired, steering tested, passage resumed — under the CP off-hire clause.

Bunkers used while off hire (VLSFO 1.1 t, generators and boiler) are for the owners' account.

Could your vessel technical management please provide the engine log extract for the stop?

Operations
